definitions.truth:
(normalised truth lineage, basis). The QNA-020 tracer's lineage
    (eval_reference_lookup.trace_ground_truth: named reference-builder
    records, LCA over copies) wins; a row it could not trace falls back to
    the LCA over named copies from the dataset-only sources, then over all
    copies (names like 'uncultured Salmo sp.' keep their genus).
definitions.rank_metrics:
Rank-aware precision/recall over (predicted lineage, true lineage) pairs.

    At rank R only rows whose truth has a value at R are gradable. A row is
    called at R when its predicted lineage has a value at R (a species call
    is also a genus and a family call); it is correct when that value equals
    the truth's. precision = correct / called, recall = correct / gradable.
    Rows with truth but no call count against recall only.
definitions.predicted:
(effective, uncapped) predicted lineage of one evaluated row.

    effective: the lineage behind decision.predicted_taxon -- the final
    route's reference assignment, cut at decision.taxon_rank (so the genus
    cap's dropped species is gone). uncapped: the same assignment before
    the genus cap (the trace keeps the reference payload as searched).
    Both empty when the decision names no taxon.
definitions.relabel_verdict:
(verdict, reason, agreement) for one possible_novelty row the orchestrator
    relabelled known_species / likely_taxonomic_group.

      label_noise        the hit is the same source record in another
                         database (shared accession); or the source records
                         name the hit's species; or its genus (and no
                         conflicting species); or, when the source names
                         nothing below family, the hit's family. The
                         sequence then sits in a taxon its own record
                         names, and only the 'uncultured / environmental'
                         wording made the label. The reason says at which
                         rank the names agree.
      real_disagreement  the source names a different genus, the same genus
                         but a different species, or a different family
      undetermined       the source carries no name to compare ('uncultured
                         bacterium', 'marine metagenome'), or the hit and the
                         source share no rank to compare, and no shared
                         accession
    agreement: the rank at which source and hit names agree ('accession',
    'species', 'genus', 'family'), None unless label_noise. A genus or
    family agreement shows the hit does not contradict the source; it does
    not show the source was a known species.
    row_names: names_in(all copies); named_copy_names: names_in(copies with
    a usable organism name), only used to word the reason.
definitions.same_specimen: same_accession: a final-route hit at >= 99% identity whose reference record (any merged copy) shares an accession with the row's source records; possible_not_confirmable: assignment identity >= 99% but no shared accession (RefSeq and INSDC copies of one specimen carry different accessions, so this cannot be excluded); no_identity_below_99.
definitions.leaky: exact row or source record in a ref.fasta, or any planned-route hit >= 99% from the same source record (shared accession; SILVA accessions are compared without their start.end coordinates, so another rRNA operon copy of the same genome assembly counts as the same record), or a GRCh38 window row (the GRCh38 BLAST index is the whole genome, held-out windows included)
definitions.human_genome_hit: the human route's GRCh38 BLAST screen hit the row (payload.human_genome.hit); it flags contamination but sets no taxon
